items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: the greatest guy in the Cuban independence, was black. Quintin Bandera

ctx.x: No, but you yourself and other Afro-Cubans, Were there any complexes because they were black and made to feel inferior because of a racist government that instilled this in the public mind?
Well, the most important thing is that the greatest warrior, the greatest guy in the Cuban independence, was black. Quintin Bandera, the whole family of Maceo, there was about five.......
